items.title: Tony Marino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 25, 2025
items.q: I used to play a lot ... when I was young ... And then take a break, come back and play free again ... And so then we would finish playing free and then we would play tunes like Bill Evans’ trio.

ctx.x: Okay you have to explain that.

Well okay, Scott LaFaro was a heavy member of Bill Evans’ trio. Piano trio. And Bill had a new concept which was the bass part doesn’t hold the time-keeping role, which you mentioned before. He’s more of a counterpoint player you know. And more of a soloist. And Scott was a genius you know. Also a heavy practitioner. He practiced a lot. So he was able to do horn-like riffs on the bass and we marveled at his virtuosity. You know. And stories I’ve heard, I wasn’t there you know, I never got to see him play live,…
